top_signals.title: FTSE 100 Live: Stocks to fall; oil drops to $90 but Trump warns ‘powerful’ return to war
top_signals.summary: Welcome back to the City AM FTSE 100 liveblog. It’s Tuesday morning and the UK’s blue-chip index is set to drop into the red despite making gains on Monday. The markets took a boost yesterday after oil dropped back after reaching two-month highs of more than $100 per barrel last week when the Iran backed-Houthis took responsibility [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: How cricket could become the IOC’s gateway to India
top_signals.summary: Cricket offers the International Olympic Committee something no recent addition has: direct access to a fan base of more than 2 billion people.
